# Phase 5a-3i: Scheduled Reports

Build report scheduling and export generation. Phase 5a-2 (custom dashboards) is complete in the current directory. Some scaffolding files already exist — review them and complete the TODO implementations.

## Report Backend

Create `ReportController` at `/api/reports` and `ScheduledReportService`. Role: ADMIN/REVIEWER.

**POST /scheduled** — Body: `{ dashboardConfigId, cronExpression }`. Validate cron format. Calculate `next_run_at` from cron. Set `is_active=true`.

**GET /scheduled** — list current user's schedules.

**PUT /scheduled/{id}** — update cron or active status (owner only).

**DELETE /scheduled/{id}** — delete (owner only).

**GET /exports** — list current user's generated report exports.

**GET /exports/{id}/download** — download the export file.

## Scheduler

`ScheduledReportService` with `@Scheduled(cron = "0 * * * * *")` (every minute): query `scheduled_reports` where `is_active=true AND next_run_at <= now()`. For each due report: execute the linked dashboard config's query (reuse DashboardService), write CSV to `{FILE_STORAGE_PATH}/reports/{reportId}-{timestamp}.csv`, create `report_exports` record, update `last_run_at`, calculate `next_run_at` from cron expression.

## Vue Pages

**ReportScheduler.vue** (`/analytics/reports`): el-table: Dashboard Name, Schedule (human-readable like "Daily at 2:00 AM"), Last Run, Next Run, Active (el-switch toggle), Actions (Edit/Delete). "Schedule New Report" → el-dialog: select dashboard dropdown, schedule presets as el-radio-group ("Daily at 2 AM" = `0 0 2 * * *`, "Weekly Monday 8 AM" = `0 0 8 * * MON`, "Monthly 1st midnight" = `0 0 0 1 * *`) plus "Custom" option with cron text input.

**ReportExports.vue** (`/analytics/exports`): el-table: Dashboard Name, Generated At, Masked (yes/no el-tag), File Size, "Download" button.

Create `api/reports.js` with: `getScheduledReports`, `createScheduledReport`, `updateScheduledReport`, `deleteScheduledReport`, `getExports`, `downloadExport`.

## Verification
1. Create a schedule with "every minute" cron. 2. Export appears in list within 1-2 minutes. 3. Download returns valid CSV with correct data. 4. Active toggle pauses/resumes the schedule. 5. Delete removes the schedule. 6. Only owner can manage their schedules.

138:         if (rows.isEmpty()) {
139:             return new byte[0];
140:         }
141:         byte[] csv = toCsv(rows);
142:         String path = String.format("reports/%s-%s.csv", id, UUID.randomUUID());
143:         fileStorageService.save(path, csv);
144:         auditService.log(user.id(), "EXPORT_DASHBOARD", "DashboardConfig", id, null, rows);
145:         return csv;
146:     }
147: 
148:     List<Map<String, Object>> execute(DashboardConfig config) {
149:         return executeQuery(config);
150:     }
151: 
152:     private List<Map<String, Object>> executeQuery(DashboardConfig config) {
153:         List<String> metrics = objectMapper.convertValue(config.getMetricsJson(), new TypeReference<>() {});
154:         String dimension = objectMapper.convertValue(config.getDimensionsJson(), String.class);
155:         Map<String, Object> filters = config.getFiltersJson() != null ? objectMapper.convertValue(config.getFiltersJson(), Map.class) : Map.of();
156: 
157:         Map<String, Map<String, Object>> rows = new LinkedHashMap<>();
158:         for (String metric : metrics) {
159:             List<Map<String, Object>> results = queryMetric(metric, dimension, filters);
160:             for (Map<String, Object> row : results) {
161:                 String key = row.get("dimension").toString();
162:                 Map<String, Object> entry = rows.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> {
163:                     Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
164:                     map.put("dimension", k);
165:                     return map;
166:                 });
167:                 entry.put(metric, row.get("value"));
168:             }
169:         }
170:         return new ArrayList<>(rows.values());
171:     }
172: 
173:     private List<Map<String, Object>> queryMetric(String metric, String dimension, Map<String, Object> filters) {
174:         String table;
175:         String condition = "";
176:         String join = "";
177:         switch (metric) {
178:             case "post_volume":
179:                 table = "job_postings";
180:                 break;
181:             case "claim_count":
182:                 table = "claims";
183:                 break;
184:             case "review_count":
185:             case "approval_rate":
186:             case "handling_time":
187:             case "takedown_count":
188:                 table = "review_actions";
189:                 break;
190:             default:
191:                 throw new BusinessException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "metric: Unsupported");
192:         }
193:         Instant from = filters.containsKey("dateFrom") ? Instant.parse(filters.get("dateFrom").toString()) : Instant.now().minusSeconds(30 * 86400);
194:         Instant to = filters.containsKey("dateTo") ? Instant.parse(filters.get("dateTo").toString()) : Instant.now();
195:         List<String> statuses = filters.containsKey("statuses") ? (List<String>) filters.get("statuses") : List.of();
196: 
197:         String dimensionExpr = resolveDimension(dimension, table);
198:         String base = switch (dimension) {
199:             case "status" -> "job_postings.status";
200:             case "category" -> "categories.name";
201:             case "location_state" -> "locations.state";
202:             case "reviewer" -> "users.username";
203:             default -> dimensionExpr;
204:         };
205: 
206:         String metricExpr = switch (metric) {
207:             case "post_volume", "claim_count", "review_count" -> "COUNT(*)";
208:             case "approval_rate" -> "SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'APPROVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)";
209:             case "handling_time" -> "AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, jp.created_at, ra.created_at))";
210:             case "takedown_count" -> "SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'TAKEDOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)";
211:             default -> "COUNT(*)";
212:         };
213: 
214:         String sql = "SELECT " + dimensionExpr + " AS dimension, " + metricExpr + " AS value FROM " + table + " ";
215:         if (dimension.equals("category")) {
216:             sql += "JOIN categories ON categories.id = job_postings.category_id ";
217:         }
218:         if (dimension.equals("location_state")) {
219:             sql += "JOIN locations ON locations.id = job_postings.location_id ";
220:         }
221:         if (dimension.equals("reviewer")) {
222:             sql += "JOIN users ON users.id = review_actions.reviewer_id ";
223:         }
224:         sql += "WHERE created_at >= :from AND created_at <= :to ";
225:         if (!statuses.isEmpty()) {
226:             sql += "AND job_postings.status IN (" + statuses.stream().map(s -> "'" + s + "'").reduce((a, b) -> a + "," + b).orElse("") + ") ";
227:         }
228:         if (metric.equals("handling_time")) {
229:             sql += "AND review_actions.job_posting_id = job_postings.id ";
230:             sql += "JOIN job_postings jp ON jp.id = review_actions.job_posting_id ";
231:         }
232:         sql += "GROUP BY dimension ORDER BY dimension";
233: 
234:         Query query = entityManager.createNativeQuery(sql);
235:         query.setParameter("from", from);
236:         query.setParameter("to", to);
237:         List<Object[]> raw = query.getResultList();
238:         List<Map<String, Object>> rows = new ArrayList<>();
239:         for (Object[] row : raw) {
240:             Map<String, Object> map = new HashMap<>();
241:             map.put("dimension", row[0]);
242:             map.put("value", row[1]);
243:             rows.add(map);
244:         }
245:         return rows;
246:     }
247: 
248:     private String resolveDimension(String dimension, String table) {
249:         return switch (dimension) {
250:             case "date_daily" -> "DATE(created_at)";
251:             case "date_weekly" -> "DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%x-%v')";
252:             case "date_monthly" -> "DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m')";
253:             case "status" -> "job_postings.status";
254:             case "category" -> "categories.name";
255:             case "location_state" -> "locations.state";
256:             case "reviewer" -> "users.username";
257:             default -> "DATE(created_at)";
258:         };
259:     }

261:     byte[] toCsv(List<Map<String, Object>> rows) {
262:         try (ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
263:              OutputStreamWriter writer = new OutputStreamWriter(bos, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
264:              CSVPrinter printer = new CSVPrinter(writer, CSVFormat.DEFAULT.withHeader(rows.get(0).keySet().toArray(new String[0])))) {
265:             for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
266:                 printer.printRecord(row.values());
267:             }
268:             printer.flush();
269:             return bos.toByteArray();
270:         } catch (IOException e) {
271:             throw new RuntimeException(e);
272:         }
273:     }

# AES-256 encryption — complete encrypt/decrypt, converter, and unmasked endpoint

## Files to modify

1. Open `backend/src/main/java/com/shiftworks/jobops/service/EncryptionService.java`. Two methods throw `UnsupportedOperationException`. Replace with real implementations:

   **`encrypt(String plaintext)`**:
   - Generate 12-byte random IV: `byte[] iv = new byte[IV_BYTES]; secureRandom.nextBytes(iv);`
   - Get cipher: `Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance(ALGORITHM);`
   - Init encrypt: `cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, keySpec, new GCMParameterSpec(GCM_TAG_BITS, iv));`
   - Encrypt: `byte[] ciphertext = cipher.doFinal(plaintext.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));`
   - Combine IV + ciphertext: `byte[] combined = new byte[iv.length + ciphertext.length];` then `System.arraycopy` both
   - Return: `Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(combined)`
   - Wrap in try-catch, throw `IllegalStateException("Encryption failed", e)` on error

   **`decrypt(String ciphertext)`**:
   - Decode: `byte[] combined = Base64.getDecoder().decode(ciphertext);`
   - Extract IV: `byte[] iv = new byte[IV_BYTES]; System.arraycopy(combined, 0, iv, 0, IV_BYTES);`
   - Get cipher: `Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance(ALGORITHM);`
   - Init decrypt: `cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, keySpec, new GCMParameterSpec(GCM_TAG_BITS, iv));`
   - Decrypt: `byte[] plainBytes = cipher.doFinal(combined, IV_BYTES, combined.length - IV_BYTES);`
   - Return: `new String(plainBytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)`
   - Wrap in try-catch, throw `IllegalStateException("Decryption failed", e)` on error

2. Open `backend/src/main/java/com/shiftworks/jobops/converter/EncryptedStringConverter.java`. Two methods are pass-through placeholders. Replace:

   - If `attribute == null` return null
   - Return `getService().encrypt(attribute)`

   **`convertToEntityAttribute(String dbData)`**:
   - If `dbData == null` return null
   - Return `getService().decrypt(dbData)`

19: @Service
20: @RequiredArgsConstructor
21: public class SessionService {
22: 
23:     public static final String SESSION_COOKIE = "SESSION_TOKEN";
24:     public static final String CSRF_COOKIE = "XSRF-TOKEN";
25: 
26:     private final UserSessionRepository userSessionRepository;
27:     private final AppProperties appProperties;
28:     private final SecureRandom secureRandom = new SecureRandom();
29: 
30:     @Transactional
31:     public UserSession createSession(User user, String ipAddress, String userAgent) {
32:         UserSession session = new UserSession();
33:         session.setId(UUID.randomUUID().toString());
34:         session.setUser(user);
35:         session.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
36:         session.setLastActiveAt(Instant.now());
37:         session.setAbsoluteExpiry(Instant.now().plus(Duration.ofHours(appProperties.getSession().getAbsoluteTimeoutHours())));
38:         session.setValid(true);
39:         session.setIpAddress(ipAddress);
40:         session.setUserAgent(userAgent);
41:         session.setCsrfToken(generateCsrfToken());
42:         return userSessionRepository.save(session);
43:     }
44: 
45:     @Transactional(readOnly = true)
46:     public Optional<UserSession> findValidSession(String token) {
47:         if (token == null) {
48:             return Optional.empty();
49:         }
50:         return userSessionRepository.findById(token)
51:             .filter(UserSession::isValid)
52:             .filter(session -> session.getAbsoluteExpiry().isAfter(Instant.now()));
53:     }
54: 
55:     @Transactional
56:     public void touchSession(UserSession session) {
57:         session.setLastActiveAt(Instant.now());
58:         userSessionRepository.save(session);
59:     }
60: 
61:     @Transactional
62:     public void invalidateSession(UserSession session) {
63:         session.setValid(false);
64:         userSessionRepository.save(session);
65:     }
66: 
67:     @Transactional
68:     public void invalidateAllSessions(Long userId) {
69:         List<UserSession> sessions = userSessionRepository.findByUser_Id(userId);
70:         if (sessions.isEmpty()) {
71:             return;
72:         }
73:         sessions.stream()
74:             .filter(UserSession::isValid)
75:             .forEach(session -> session.setValid(false));
76:         userSessionRepository.saveAll(sessions);
77:     }

80:         byte[] bytes = new byte[32];
81:         secureRandom.nextBytes(bytes);
82:         return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(bytes);
83:     }

- Added the requested API smoke scripts in `API_tests/`: `test_auth.sh` now exercises login/registration flows, covers bad credentials/duplicate users, and verifies logout locks out access, while `test_rbac.sh` logs in as admin, provisions an employer, and confirms the employer is denied admin/review/audit endpoints.  
- Made both scripts executable and verified `API_tests/` contains `test_auth.sh` and `test_rbac.sh` with `rwx` permissions (`ls -l API_tests` output includes both).

# API tests — test_job_postings.sh and test_review.sh

Before writing, read these controllers to see the exact endpoint paths and request bodies:
- `backend/src/main/java/com/shiftworks/jobops/controller/JobPostingController.java` — base path `/api/jobs`
- `backend/src/main/java/com/shiftworks/jobops/controller/ReviewController.java` — base path `/api/review`
- `backend/src/main/java/com/shiftworks/jobops/controller/AppealController.java` — base path `/api/appeals`

Also read one DTO to understand required fields:
- `backend/src/main/java/com/shiftworks/jobops/dto/JobPostingRequest.java`

## File 1: `API_tests/test_job_postings.sh`

The script needs a category and location to exist. Login as admin and create them first, then create an employer user, login as employer, and test job posting CRUD. Use these exact endpoint paths:

- `POST /api/jobs` — create posting. Body needs: title, description, categoryId, locationId, payType, settlementType, payAmount, headcount, weeklyHours, contactPhone
- `GET /api/jobs/{id}` — get posting
- `PUT /api/jobs/{id}` — edit posting
- `POST /api/jobs/{id}/submit` — submit for review
- Categories: `POST /api/admin/categories` with `{"name":"Test Category"}`
- Locations: `POST /api/admin/locations` with `{"state":"CA","city":"Los Angeles"}`

Create the script with these tests:
1. Admin login, create category (capture ID from response using `jq .id`), create location (capture ID)
2. Create employer user via `POST /api/admin/users`
3. Login as employer
4. Create valid draft posting → check 200, capture posting ID
5. Get posting → check 200, verify `"status":"DRAFT"` in response using `jq -r .status`
6. Edit posting (change title) → check 200
7. Submit for review → check 200
8. Try edit after submit → check 400
9. Create posting with hourly pay $11 (below $12 min) → check 400
10. Create posting with headcount 0 → check 400

The valid job posting body:
```json
{
  "title": "Test Job Posting Title Here",
  "description": "This is a test job posting with enough description text to pass validation",
  "categoryId": CATEGORY_ID,
  "locationId": LOCATION_ID,
  "payType": "HOURLY",
  "settlementType": "WEEKLY",
  "payAmount": 25.00,
  "headcount": 5,
  "weeklyHours": 20,
  "contactPhone": "555-123-4567",
  "tags": ["test"]
}
```

Use `check()` helper and `PASS/FAIL` counters as in previous test files. Make executable with `chmod +x`.

## File 2: `API_tests/test_review.sh`

Full review workflow test. This script tests the entire lifecycle:

1. Login as admin, create category + location + employer user + reviewer user (via `POST /api/admin/users` with `"role":"REVIEWER"`)
2. Login as employer, create job posting, submit for review
3. Login as reviewer, call `POST /api/review/jobs/{id}/approve` with body `{"rationale":"Looks good, approved for posting"}` → check 200
4. Login as employer, call `POST /api/jobs/{id}/publish` with body `{"stepUpPassword":"StrongPass123!"}` → check 200
5. Login as reviewer, call `POST /api/review/jobs/{id}/takedown` with body `{"rationale":"Policy violation found in posting","stepUpPassword":"StrongPass123!"}` → check 200
6. Login as employer, call `POST /api/appeals` with body `{"jobPostingId":JOB_ID,"reason":"The posting complies with all policies and should be reinstated"}` → check 200, capture appeal ID
7. Login as reviewer, call `POST /api/appeals/{id}/process` with body `{"decision":"GRANTED","rationale":"Appeal is valid, reinstating the posting"}` → check 200
8. Get the posting, check status is "PUBLISHED"

Use unique usernames with timestamps to avoid conflicts. Use `jq -r .id` to extract IDs from responses. Make executable.

## Verify
List `API_tests/` to confirm test_job_postings.sh and test_review.sh exist.

1. `GET /api/admin/users` → check 200
2. `POST /api/admin/users` with `{"username":"adm_test_USER","email":"adm@test.com","password":"StrongPass123!","role":"EMPLOYER"}` → check 200, capture user ID
3. `PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/role` with `{"role":"REVIEWER","stepUpPassword":"Admin@123456789"}` → check 200
4. `GET /api/admin/audit-logs` → check 200
5. `POST /api/admin/backup/trigger` with `{"stepUpPassword":"Admin@123456789"}` → check 200
6. `GET /api/admin/backup/list` → check 200

Use unique username with timestamp. Make executable.

## File 2: `API_tests/test_files.sh`

Before writing, read:
- `backend/src/main/java/com/shiftworks/jobops/controller/FileController.java` — base `/api/files`
- `backend/src/main/java/com/shiftworks/jobops/controller/ClaimController.java` — base `/api/claims`

Create the script. Login as admin (to bypass entity access checks), create a claim first, then test file upload:

1. Login as admin
2. Create a claim via `POST /api/claims` (read the ClaimController to see the request body format)
3. Create a minimal valid PDF: `printf '%%PDF-1.4 test content here' > /tmp/test_upload.pdf`
4. Upload the PDF: `curl -s -o /tmp/upload_resp.json -w "%{http_code}" -b cookies -F "file=@/tmp/test_upload.pdf" -F "entityType=CLAIM" -F "entityId=CLAIM_ID" "$BASE/files/upload"` → check 200
5. Create an oversized file: `dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/bigfile.pdf bs=1M count=11 2>/dev/null` then upload → check 400
6. Create a .exe file: `echo "MZ" > /tmp/test.exe` then upload → check 400
7. Download the uploaded file: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b cookies "$BASE/files/FILE_ID/download"` → check 200

Clean up temp files at the end. Make executable.

## File 3: `run_tests.sh` (in project root, NOT in API_tests/)

Create this exact file at the project root:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
echo "======================================"
echo "  ShiftWorks JobOps — Test Runner"
echo "======================================"
echo ""

echo "=== Running Unit Tests ==="
cd backend && mvn test -q 2>&1
UNIT=$?
cd ..
echo ""

if [ $UNIT -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "Unit tests: PASSED"
else
  echo "Unit tests: FAILED"
fi
echo ""

echo "=== Running API Functional Tests ==="
API_FAIL=0
for script in API_tests/test_*.sh; do
  echo "--- Running $script ---"
  bash "$script"
  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    API_FAIL=$((API_FAIL+1))
  fi
  echo ""
done

echo "======================================"
echo "  Summary"
echo "======================================"
[ $UNIT -eq 0 ] && echo "  Unit tests:  PASSED" || echo "  Unit tests:  FAILED"
echo "  API scripts failed: $API_FAIL"
echo "======================================"

[ $UNIT -eq 0 ] && [ $API_FAIL -eq 0 ] && exit 0 || exit 1
```

After creating all 3 files, run:
```bash
chmod +x API_tests/test_admin.sh API_tests/test_files.sh run_tests.sh
```

+
+DOWNLOAD_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" "$BASE/files/$FILE_ID/download")

# Create docs/design.md

Create the directory `docs/` if it doesn't exist, then create `docs/design.md` with these 9 sections. Write 5-10 sentences per section:

## 1. Architecture Overview
3-tier architecture: Vue.js SPA frontend served by nginx, Spring Boot REST API backend, MySQL 8 database. All three services run in Docker Compose containers. The system is designed to operate entirely offline with no external API dependencies. The frontend communicates with the backend exclusively through `/api` endpoints proxied by nginx. The backend uses Spring Data JPA for persistence and Spring Security for authentication/authorization.

## 2. Database Design
18 tables: `users` and `user_sessions` handle authentication. `job_postings`, `job_posting_tags`, and `job_posting_history` manage the job lifecycle with full change tracking. `review_actions` and `appeals` support the approval workflow. `claims` and `tickets` handle dispute resolution. `categories` and `locations` are admin-managed dictionaries. `file_attachments` stores upload metadata. `dashboard_configs`, `scheduled_reports`, and `report_exports` power the analytics system. `alerts` holds anomaly detection results. `audit_logs` provides an immutable activity trail. `backup_records` tracks database backup history.

## 3. Auth & Security
Session-based authentication using opaque UUID tokens stored in the `user_sessions` table. Passwords are salted and hashed with bcrypt, requiring minimum 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character. HTTP-only SameSite=Strict cookies carry session tokens. CAPTCHA is required after 3 failed login attempts, and the account locks for 15 minutes after 5 failures. Sessions enforce a 30-minute idle timeout and 12-hour absolute timeout. CSRF protection uses a per-session token validated on all state-changing requests. Step-up verification (re-entering password) is required for critical operations like publishing, takedown, role changes, and unmasked data export. Rate limiting caps requests at 60 per minute per authenticated user.

## 4. Job Posting Lifecycle
Jobs follow a strict status machine: DRAFT → PENDING_REVIEW → APPROVED → PUBLISHED. Employers can only edit postings in DRAFT status. Submitting for review triggers full field validation. Reviewers can approve (→ APPROVED) or reject (→ REJECTED, with notes visible to the employer). Publishing an approved post requires step-up verification. Published posts can be unpublished by the employer or taken down by a reviewer (step-up required). Taken-down posts can be appealed by the employer (→ APPEAL_PENDING), and reviewers can grant (→ PUBLISHED) or deny (→ TAKEN_DOWN) the appeal. Every status transition is recorded in `job_posting_history` with a snapshot of the posting data.

## 5. RBAC Model
Three roles: EMPLOYER, REVIEWER, ADMIN. Authorization is enforced at two levels: Spring Security `@PreAuthorize` annotations on controller methods, and service-layer ownership checks. Employers can only access their own postings, claims, and appeals. Reviewers see postings in reviewable statuses and all pending appeals. Admins have unrestricted access to all resources including user management, dictionaries, audit logs, and backups.

## 6. File Handling
File uploads follow a validation pipeline: extension whitelist (PDF, JPG, PNG only), 10 MB size limit, magic byte verification against file header, and SHA-256 checksum fingerprinting. Files that fail magic byte verification are quarantined with status QUARANTINED for admin review. Files are stored on the local filesystem with per-record access control. PDF exports include a diagonal watermark with the requesting user's name and timestamp, rendered using Apache PDFBox.

## 7. Analytics
Built-in dashboards display post volume trends, approval rates, average handling time, reviewer activity, and claim success rates. A custom dashboard builder lets admins and reviewers select metrics and dimensions to create personalized views with live chart previews. Scheduled reports use cron expressions to auto-generate CSV exports. An anomaly detection service runs periodically to check for statistical deviations (2σ for warnings, 3σ for critical alerts) in takedown spikes, low approval rates, claim spikes, and review backlogs. Alerts appear in an admin inbox with mark-read and acknowledge actions.

## 8. Audit System
Every significant action writes an immutable record to the `audit_logs` table capturing: user ID, action name, entity type, entity ID, before/after JSON snapshots, client IP address, and timestamp. Audit records are append-only with no update or delete capability. The admin console provides a filterable, paginated view of audit logs with a detail dialog showing the full before/after JSON diff.

## 9. Backup Strategy
Database backups use `mysqldump` piped through GZIP compression and AES-256-GCM encryption. Each backup file includes a SHA-256 checksum for integrity verification. A scheduled job runs nightly, and admins can trigger manual backups through the UI. Backups are retained for 30 days with automatic cleanup. The restore workflow decrypts and decompresses the backup file, then pipes it to the MySQL client. Both backup and restore require step-up password verification.

## Verify
List `docs/` to confirm `design.md` exists.

+## Architecture Overview
+
+The platform uses a three-tier architecture: a Vue.js SPA served statically via nginx, a Spring Boot REST API backend, and a MySQL 8 database. All services are run in Docker Compose containers with clearly defined environment wiring, allowing local developers to stand up the full stack with a single command. The frontend communicates exclusively through `/api/*` endpoints, which nginx proxies to the backend, keeping the browser-side code offline-friendly without external API dependencies. The backend relies on Spring Data JPA for persistence and Spring Security for authentication, authorization, CSRF, and rate limiting. Scheduled jobs and background workers live in the Spring process, ensuring regular backups, anomaly detection, and report generation without additional services. File storage, backup artifacts, and uploads are co-located on shared Docker volumes so state persists across restarts. The layered architecture separates concerns cleanly and supports horizontal scaling of the backend + frontend containers when needed.
+
+## Database Design
+
+The database schema tracks 18 key tables. Authentication data lives in `users` (credentials, roles, statuses) and `user_sessions` (opaque session tokens, expiry metadata). The job lifecycle uses `job_postings`, `job_posting_tags`, and `job_posting_history` for the posting record, tag references, and immutable change logs. Review workflows rely on `review_actions` logging every reviewer decision and `appeals` capturing employer challenges. Disputes are tracked via `claims` (employer-submitted issues) and `tickets` (support escalations). Admin-managed dictionaries such as `categories` and `locations` supply referential data. Uploaded documents are described by `file_attachments` with checksum and status, while `dashboard_configs`, `scheduled_reports`, and `report_exports` power analytics delivery. An `alerts` table stores anomaly detection events, `audit_logs` keeps immutable action histories, and `backup_records` tracks nightly and manual backup metadata for restore operations.
+
+## Auth & Security
+
+Authentication is session-based: successful login issues an HTTP-only, SameSite=Strict cookie bearing an opaque UUID found in `user_sessions`. Passwords are salted and hashed with bcrypt, requiring at least 12 characters plus uppercase, lowercase, digits, and special characters. After three consecutive failures CAPTCHA is enforced, and after five failures accounts lock for 15 minutes. Sessions expire after 30 minutes idle or after 12 hours absolute lifetime. CSRF tokens accompany every mutating request and are validated through a filter chain. Critical operations (publishing, takedowns, role changes, backup restore/export) require step-up verification by re-entering the password. Rate limiting restricts authenticated traffic to roughly 60 requests per minute. Audit trails record every important action with IP address, before/after JSON, and actor metadata.
+
+## Job Posting Lifecycle
+
+Job postings traverse a strict state machine: DRAFT → PENDING_REVIEW → APPROVED → PUBLISHED. Employers start in DRAFT and can only edit postings while drafts. Submitting for review runs full field validation, then marks the post as PENDING_REVIEW. Reviewers approve (→ APPROVED) or reject (→ REJECTED with explicit rationale stored for the employer). Publishing requires step-up authentication and transitions APPROVED posts to PUBLISHED. Published posts can be unpublished by the employer or taken down by reviewers (with step-up) into TAKEN_DOWN, and takedown reasons are recorded. Employers may then appeal, sending the posting into APPEAL_PENDING; reviewers can grant (→ PUBLISHED again) or deny (→ TAKEN_DOWN) appeals, both captured in `job_posting_history` along with JSON snapshots for auditing.
+
+## RBAC Model
+
+The system exposes three roles: EMPLOYER, REVIEWER, and ADMIN. Authorization is enforced via Spring Security's `@PreAuthorize` annotations on every controller endpoint plus service-layer ownership checks. Employers can only manipulate their own postings, claims, and appeals. Reviewers are granted access to all reviewable postings, review queues, and pending appeals, while admins enjoy unrestricted full-access capabilities. Role transitions and sensitive admin operations require step-up verification and are logged via the audit service.
+
+## File Handling
+
+Uploaded files pass through a validation pipeline: allowed extensions (PDF, JPG, PNG), a 10 MB size cap, and magic-byte verification ensure content matches the claimed format. SHA-256 checksums provide tamper evidence, and records track upload status and quarantine state. Files failing the magic check are quarantined for admin review. Files are stored on the filesystem with path metadata persisted in `file_attachments`. When CSV exports are performed and PDFs are generated, Apache PDFBox stamps a watermark with the viewer's username and timestamp to mark sensitive downloads.
+
+## Analytics
+
+Built-in dashboards cover post volume, approval rates, handling time, reviewer activity, and claim success. Admins can also build custom dashboards by selecting metrics, dimensions, and filters, previewing the results instantly. Scheduled reports run via cron expressions and generate CSVs stored on disk; the scheduler logs each export in `report_exports`. An anomaly detection cron job runs every minute, calculating sigma thresholds across takedown spikes, low approval rates, claim spikes, and review backlogs, issuing alerts that appear in a dedicated admin inbox for acknowledgment. Custom dashboards and alerts are backed by reusable SQL builders that respect filters, joins, and date ranges.
+
+## Audit System
+
+Every significant event writes to `audit_logs` with the acting user, action name, entity type/id, before/after JSON, IP address, and timestamps. Audit log entries are append-only: there are no update or delete operations, ensuring an immutable trail. The admin interface offers filtering by entity, action, user, and time range with pagination. Clicking an audit row shows the JSON diff of the before/after state.
+
+## Backup Strategy
+
+Nightly backups use `mysqldump` piped through GZIP compression and AES-256-GCM encryption with a 12-byte IV. Each backup file stores the checksum alongside metadata in `backup_records`, and backups are kept for 30 days with automatic cleanup of expired files. Administrators can trigger manual backups via the UI, which also records the action in the audit log. The restore operation decrypts the backup, decompresses it, and streams it into `mysql`, requiring step-up password verification; errors are logged and surfaced to the admin.
*** End Patch"}

All services are run in Docker Compose containers with clearly defined environment wiring, allowing local developers to stand up the full stack with a single command. The frontend communicates exclusively through `/api/*` endpoints, which nginx proxies to the backend, keeping the browser-side code offline-friendly without external API dependencies. The backend relies on Spring Data JPA for persistence and Spring Security for authentication, authorization, CSRF, and rate limiting. Scheduled jobs and background workers live in the Spring process, ensuring regular backups, anomaly detection, and report generation without additional services. File storage, backup artifacts, and uploads are co-located on shared Docker volumes so state persists across restarts. The layered architecture separates concerns cleanly and supports horizontal scaling of the backend + frontend containers when needed.
+
+## Database Design
+
+The database schema tracks 18 key tables. Authentication data lives in `users` (credentials, roles, statuses) and `user_sessions` (opaque session tokens, expiry metadata). The job lifecycle uses `job_postings`, `job_posting_tags`, and `job_posting_history` for the posting record, tag references, and immutable change logs. Review workflows rely on `review_actions` logging every reviewer decision and `appeals` capturing employer challenges. Disputes are tracked via `claims` (employer-submitted issues) and `tickets` (support escalations). Admin-managed dictionaries such as `categories` and `locations` supply referential data. Uploaded documents are described by `file_attachments` with checksum and status, while `dashboard_configs`, `scheduled_reports`, and `report_exports` power analytics delivery. An `alerts` table stores anomaly detection events, `audit_logs` keeps immutable action histories, and `backup_records` tracks nightly and manual backup metadata for restore operations.
+
+## Auth & Security
+
+Authentication is session-based: successful login issues an HTTP-only, SameSite=Strict cookie bearing an opaque UUID found in `user_sessions`. Passwords are salted and hashed with bcrypt, requiring at least 12 characters plus uppercase, lowercase, digits, and special characters. After three consecutive failures CAPTCHA is enforced, and after five failures accounts lock for 15 minutes. Sessions expire after 30 minutes idle or after 12 hours absolute lifetime. CSRF tokens accompany every mutating request and are validated through a filter chain. Critical operations (publishing, takedowns, role changes, backup restore/export) require step-up verification by re-entering the password. Rate limiting restricts authenticated traffic to roughly 60 requests per minute. Audit trails record every important action with IP address, before/after JSON, and actor metadata.
+
+## Job Posting Lifecycle
+
+Job postings traverse a strict state machine: DRAFT → PENDING_REVIEW → APPROVED → PUBLISHED. Employers start in DRAFT and can only edit postings while drafts. Submitting for review runs full field validation, then marks the post as PENDING_REVIEW. Reviewers approve (→ APPROVED) or reject (→ REJECTED with explicit rationale stored for the employer). Publishing requires step-up authentication and transitions APPROVED posts to PUBLISHED. Published posts can be unpublished by the employer or taken down by reviewers (with step-up) into TAKEN_DOWN, and takedown reasons are recorded. +The system exposes three roles: EMPLOYER, REVIEWER, and ADMIN. Authorization is enforced via Spring Security's `@PreAuthorize` annotations on every controller endpoint plus service-layer ownership checks. Employers can only manipulate their own postings, claims, and appeals. Reviewers are granted access to all reviewable postings, review queues, and pending appeals, while admins enjoy unrestricted full-access capabilities. Role transitions and sensitive admin operations require step-up verification and are logged via the audit service.
+
+## File Handling
+
+Uploaded files pass through a validation pipeline: allowed extensions (PDF, JPG, PNG), a 10 MB size cap, and magic-byte verification ensure content matches the claimed format. SHA-256 checksums provide tamper evidence, and records track upload status and quarantine state. Files failing the magic check are quarantined for admin review. Files are stored on the filesystem with path metadata persisted in `file_attachments`. When CSV exports are performed and PDFs are generated, Apache PDFBox stamps a watermark with the viewer's username and timestamp to mark sensitive downloads.
+
+## Analytics
+
+Built-in dashboards cover post volume, approval rates, handling time, reviewer activity, and claim success. Admins can also build custom dashboards by selecting metrics, dimensions, and filters, previewing the results instantly. Scheduled reports run via cron expressions and generate CSVs stored on disk; the scheduler logs each export in `report_exports`. An anomaly detection cron job runs every minute, calculating sigma thresholds across takedown spikes, low approval rates, claim spikes, and review backlogs, issuing alerts that appear in a dedicated admin inbox for acknowledgment. Custom dashboards and alerts are backed by reusable SQL builders that respect filters, joins, and date ranges.
+
+## Audit System
+
+Every significant event writes to `audit_logs` with the acting user, action name, entity type/id, before/after JSON, IP address, and timestamps. Audit log entries are append-only: there are no update or delete operations, ensuring an immutable trail. The admin interface offers filtering by entity, action, user, and time range with pagination. Clicking an audit row shows the JSON diff of the before/after state.
+
+## Backup Strategy
+
+Nightly backups use `mysqldump` piped through GZIP compression and AES-256-GCM encryption with a 12-byte IV. Each backup file stores the checksum alongside metadata in `backup_records`, and backups are kept for 30 days with automatic cleanup of expired files. Administrators can trigger manual backups via the UI, which also records the action in the audit log. The restore operation decrypts the backup, decompresses it, and streams it into `mysql`, requiring step-up password verification; errors are logged and surfaced to the admin.

18: import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
19: import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
20: import org.springframework.http.ResponseCookie;
21: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
22: import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
23: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
24: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
25: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
26: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
27: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
28: 
29: import java.time.Duration;
30: import java.util.Map;
31: 
32: @RestController
33: @RequestMapping("/api/auth")
34: @RequiredArgsConstructor
35: public class AuthController {
36: 
37:     private final AuthService authService;
38:     private final CaptchaService captchaService;
39:     private final AppProperties appProperties;
40: 
41:     @PostMapping("/login")
42:     public ResponseEntity<?> login(@Valid @RequestBody LoginRequest request, HttpServletRequest httpRequest, HttpServletResponse httpResponse) {
43:         boolean captchaPassed = request.captchaId() != null && captchaService.validate(request.captchaId(), request.captchaAnswer());
44:         var result = authService.login(request, httpRequest, captchaPassed);
45:         if (!result.isSuccess()) {
46:             return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED).body(Map.of(
47:                 "code", HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED.value(),
48:                 "message", AuthService.LOGIN_FAILURE,
49:                 "captchaRequired", result.failure().captchaRequired(),
50:                 "remainingAttempts", result.failure().remainingAttempts()
51:             ));
52:         }
53:         LoginResponse response = result.response();
54:         addSessionCookies(httpResponse, result.sessionToken(), response.csrfToken());
55:         return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
56:     }
57: 
58:     @PostMapping("/logout")
59:     public ResponseEntity<Void> logout(Authentication authentication, HttpServletResponse response) {
60:         if (authentication == null || !(authentication.getPrincipal() instanceof AuthenticatedUser user)) {
61:             return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED).build();
62:         }
63:         authService.logout(user.id());
64:         clearSessionCookies(response);
65:         return ResponseEntity.ok().build();
66:     }
67: 
68:     @PostMapping("/register")
69:     public ResponseEntity<UserResponse> register(@Valid @RequestBody RegisterRequest request) {
70:         UserResponse user = authService.register(request);
71:         return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(user);
72:     }
73: 
74:     @GetMapping("/captcha")
75:     public ResponseEntity<CaptchaResponse> captcha() {
76:         var captcha = captchaService.generateCaptcha();
77:         return ResponseEntity.ok(new CaptchaResponse(captcha.captchaId(), "data:image/png;base64," + captcha.imageBase64()));
78:     }
79: 
80:     @PostMapping("/change-password")
81:     public ResponseEntity<Void> changePassword(Authentication authentication, @Valid @RequestBody ChangePasswordRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) {
82:         if (authentication == null || !(authentication.getPrincipal() instanceof AuthenticatedUser user)) {
83:             return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED).build();
84:         }
85:         authService.changePassword(user.id(), request);
86:         clearSessionCookies(response);
87:         return ResponseEntity.ok().build();
88:     }
89: 
90:     @GetMapping("/me")
91:     public ResponseEntity<UserResponse> me(Authentication authentication) {
92:         if (authentication == null || !(authentication.getPrincipal() instanceof AuthenticatedUser user)) {
93:             return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED).build();
94:         }
95:         return ResponseEntity.ok(authService.me(user.id()));
96:     }
97: 
98:     private void addSessionCookies(HttpServletResponse response, String sessionToken, String csrfToken) {
99:         Duration sessionDuration = Duration.ofHours(appProperties.getSession().getAbsoluteTimeoutHours());
100:         ResponseCookie sessionCookie = ResponseCookie.from(SessionService.SESSION_COOKIE, sessionToken)
101:             .path("/")
102:             .httpOnly(true)
103:             .sameSite("Strict")
104:             .secure(false)
105:             .maxAge(sessionDuration)
106:             .build();
107:         ResponseCookie csrfCookie = ResponseCookie.from(SessionService.CSRF_COOKIE, csrfToken)
108:             .path("/")
109:             .httpOnly(false)
110:             .sameSite("Strict")
111:             .secure(false)
112:             .maxAge(sessionDuration)
113:             .build();
114:         response.addHeader(HttpHeaders.SET_COOKIE, sessionCookie.toString());
115:         response.addHeader(HttpHeaders.SET_COOKIE, csrfCookie.toString());
116:     }
117: 
118:     private void clearSessionCookies(HttpServletResponse response) {
119:         ResponseCookie sessionCookie = ResponseCookie.from(SessionService.SESSION_COOKIE, "")
120:             .path("/")
121:             .httpOnly(true)
122:             .sameSite("Strict")
123:             .maxAge(0)
124:             .build();
125:         ResponseCookie csrfCookie = ResponseCookie.from(SessionService.CSRF_COOKIE, "")
126:             .path("/")
127:             .httpOnly(false)
128:             .sameSite("Strict")
129:             .maxAge(0)
130:             .build();
131:         response.addHeader(HttpHeaders.SET_COOKIE, sessionCookie.toString());
132:         response.addHeader(HttpHeaders.SET_COOKIE, csrfCookie.toString());
133:     }
134: }

{"patchText": "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: docs/api-spec.md
+# ShiftWorks JobOps — API Specification
+
+## Authentication
+
+### POST /api/auth/login
+- **Auth**: None
+- **Body**: `{ "username": "string", "password": "string", "captchaId": "string?", "captchaAnswer": "string?" }`
+- **Response**: `{ "user": {...}, "csrfToken": "string", "passwordExpired": boolean }
+- **Errors**: 401 Unauthorized (invalid creds or captcha required, includes `captchaRequired`/`remainingAttempts` fields)
+
+### POST /api/auth/logout
+- **Auth**: Required
+- **Body**: None
+- **Response**: `204 No Content`
+- **Errors**: 401 when not authenticated
+
+### POST /api/auth/register
+- **Auth**: None
+- **Body**: `{ "username": "string", "email": "string", "password": "string" }`
+- **Response**: `201 Created` user payload
+- **Errors**: 400 bad password, 409 duplicate username/email
+
+### GET /api/auth/captcha
+- **Auth**: None
+- **Body**: None
+- **Response**: `{ "captchaId": "string", "image": "data:image/png;base64,..." }`
+
+### POST /api/auth/change-password
+- **Auth**: Required
+- **Body**: `{ "newPassword": "string" }`
+- **Response**: `200 OK`
+- **Errors**: 401 unauthorized, 400 policy violations list
+
+### GET /api/auth/me
+- **Auth**: Required
+- **Body**: None
+- **Response**: `UserResponse`
+- **Errors**: 401 unauthorized
+
+## Job Postings
+
+### GET /api/jobs
+- **Auth**: Required
+- **Body**: query parameters `status`, `categoryId`, `locationId`, `search`, `page`, `size`, `sort`, `direction`
+- **Response**: `PageResponse<JobPostingResponse>` (paged postings for user with masked fields)
+- **Errors**: 403 forbidden if role access violation
+
+### GET /api/jobs/summary
+- **Auth**: Required
+- **Body**: None
+- **Response**: `JobPostingSummaryResponse`
+
+### GET /api/jobs/{id}
+- **Auth**: Required
+- **Body**: None
+- **Response**: `JobPostingResponse` (masking phone for unauthorized users)
+- **Errors**: 404 not found, 403 if access denied
+
+### POST /api/jobs
+- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
+- **Body**: `JobPostingRequest` (title, description, categoryId, locationId, payType, settlementType, payAmount, headcount, weeklyHours, contactPhone, tags, validityStart, validityEnd)
+- **Response**: `JobPostingResponse` (new draft)
+- **Errors**: 400 validation failures
+
+### PUT /api/jobs/{id}
+- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
+- **Body**: `JobPostingRequest`
+- **Response**: Updated `JobPostingResponse`
+- **Errors**: 400 invalid status/fields, 403 unauthorized, 404 not found
+
+### POST /api/jobs/{id}/submit
+- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
+- **Body**: None
+- **Response**: `200 OK`
+- **Errors**: 400 invalid status, 403 unauthorized
+
+### POST /api/jobs/{id}/publish
+- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
+- **Body**: `PublishJobRequest { "stepUpPassword": "string" }`
+- **Response**: `200 OK`
+- **Errors**: 400 invalid status, 403 step-up failed
+
+### POST /api/jobs/{id}/unpublish
+- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
+- **Body**: None
+- **Response**: `200 OK`
+- **Errors**: 400 invalid status, 403 unauthorized
+
+### GET /api/jobs/{id}/preview
+- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
+- **Body**: None
+- **Response**: `JobPostingPreviewResponse`
+
+### GET /api/jobs/{id}/history
+- **Auth**: Required
+- **Body**: None
+- **Response**: `List<JobPostingHistoryResponse>`
+
+### POST /api/jobs/{id}/contact-phone
+- **Auth**: ADMIN
+- **Body**: `StepUpPhoneRequest { "stepUpPassword": "string" }`
+- **Response**: `{ "contactPhone": "string" }`
+- **Errors**: 403 step-up failure, 404 not found
+
+## Dictionaries
+
+### GET /api/categories
+- **Auth**: Required
+- **Body**: None
+- **Response**: `List<CategoryResponse>`
+
+### GET /api/locations
+- **Auth**: Required
+- **Body**: Optional `state` query string
+- **Response**: `List<LocationResponse>`
+
+### GET /api/locations/states
+- **Auth**: Required
+- **Body**: None
+- **Response**: `List<String>` (active states)
+
+## Review
+
+### GET /api/review/dashboard

# ShiftWorks JobOps — API Specification

## Authentication

### POST /api/auth/login
- **Auth**: None
- **Body**: `{ "username": "string", "password": "string", "captchaId": "string?", "captchaAnswer": "string?" }`
- **Response**: `{ "user": {...}, "csrfToken": "string", "passwordExpired": boolean }
- **Errors**: 401 Unauthorized (invalid creds or captcha required, includes `captchaRequired`/`remainingAttempts` fields)

### POST /api/auth/logout
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `204 No Content`
- **Errors**: 401 when not authenticated

### POST /api/auth/register
- **Auth**: None
- **Body**: `{ "username": "string", "email": "string", "password": "string" }`
- **Response**: `201 Created` user payload
- **Errors**: 400 bad password, 409 duplicate username/email

### GET /api/auth/captcha
- **Auth**: None
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `{ "captchaId": "string", "image": "data:image/png;base64,..." }`

### POST /api/auth/change-password
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: `{ "newPassword": "string" }`
- **Response**: `200 OK`
- **Errors**: 401 unauthorized, 400 policy violations list

### GET /api/auth/me
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `UserResponse`
- **Errors**: 401 unauthorized

## Job Postings

### GET /api/jobs
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: query parameters `status`, `categoryId`, `locationId`, `search`, `page`, `size`, `sort`, `direction`
- **Response**: `PageResponse<JobPostingResponse>` (paged postings for user with masked fields)
- **Errors**: 403 forbidden if role access violation

### GET /api/jobs/summary
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `JobPostingSummaryResponse`

### GET /api/jobs/{id}
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `JobPostingResponse` (masking phone for unauthorized users)
- **Errors**: 404 not found, 403 if access denied

### POST /api/jobs
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: `JobPostingRequest` (title, description, categoryId, locationId, payType, settlementType, payAmount, headcount, weeklyHours, contactPhone, tags, validityStart, validityEnd)
- **Response**: `JobPostingResponse` (new draft)
- **Errors**: 400 validation failures

### PUT /api/jobs/{id}
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: `JobPostingRequest`
- **Response**: Updated `JobPostingResponse`
- **Errors**: 400 invalid status/fields, 403 unauthorized, 404 not found

### POST /api/jobs/{id}/submit
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `200 OK`
- **Errors**: 400 invalid status, 403 unauthorized

### POST /api/jobs/{id}/publish
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: `PublishJobRequest { "stepUpPassword": "string" }`
- **Response**: `200 OK`
- **Errors**: 400 invalid status, 403 step-up failed

### POST /api/jobs/{id}/unpublish
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `200 OK`
- **Errors**: 400 invalid status, 403 unauthorized

### GET /api/jobs/{id}/preview
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `JobPostingPreviewResponse`

### GET /api/jobs/{id}/history
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `List<JobPostingHistoryResponse>`

### POST /api/jobs/{id}/contact-phone
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: `StepUpPhoneRequest { "stepUpPassword": "string" }`
- **Response**: `{ "contactPhone": "string" }`
- **Errors**: 403 step-up failure, 404 not found

## Dictionaries

### GET /api/categories
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `List<CategoryResponse>`

### GET /api/locations
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: Optional `state` query string
- **Response**: `List<LocationResponse>`

### GET /api/locations/states
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `List<String>` (active states)

## Review

### GET /api/review/dashboard
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `ReviewDashboardResponse`

### GET /api/review/queue
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: Query params `page`, `size`
- **Response**: `PageResponse<JobPostingResponse>`

### GET /api/review/jobs/{id}
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `JobPostingResponse`

### GET /api/review/jobs/{id}/diff
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `Map<String, FieldDiff>`

### GET /api/review/jobs/{id}/actions
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `List<ReviewActionResponse>`

### POST /api/review/jobs/{id}/approve
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: `ReviewRationaleRequest { "rationale": "string" }`
- **Response**: `200 OK`

### POST /api/review/jobs/{id}/reject
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: `ReviewRejectRequest { "rationale": "string", "reviewerNotes": "string?" }`
- **Response**: `200 OK`

# ShiftWorks JobOps — API Specification

## Authentication

### POST /api/auth/login
- **Auth**: None
- **Body**: `{ "username": "string", "password": "string", "captchaId": "string?", "captchaAnswer": "string?" }`
- **Response**: `{ "user": {...}, "csrfToken": "string", "passwordExpired": boolean }
- **Errors**: 401 Unauthorized (invalid creds or captcha required, includes `captchaRequired`/`remainingAttempts` fields)

### POST /api/auth/logout
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `204 No Content`
- **Errors**: 401 when not authenticated

### POST /api/auth/register
- **Auth**: None
- **Body**: `{ "username": "string", "email": "string", "password": "string" }`
- **Response**: `201 Created` user payload
- **Errors**: 400 bad password, 409 duplicate username/email

### GET /api/auth/captcha
- **Auth**: None
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `{ "captchaId": "string", "image": "data:image/png;base64,..." }`

### POST /api/auth/change-password
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: `{ "newPassword": "string" }`
- **Response**: `200 OK`
- **Errors**: 401 unauthorized, 400 policy violations list

### GET /api/auth/me
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `UserResponse`
- **Errors**: 401 unauthorized

- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: query parameters `status`, `categoryId`, `locationId`, `search`, `page`, `size`, `sort`, `direction`

- **Errors**: 403 forbidden if role access violation

### GET /api/jobs/summary
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `JobPostingSummaryResponse`

### GET /api/jobs/{id}
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `JobPostingResponse` (masking phone for unauthorized users)
- **Errors**: 404 not found, 403 if access denied

### POST /api/jobs
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: `JobPostingRequest` (title, description, categoryId, locationId, payType, settlementType, payAmount, headcount, weeklyHours, contactPhone, tags, validityStart, validityEnd)
- **Response**: `JobPostingResponse` (new draft)
- **Errors**: 400 validation failures

- **Body**: `JobPostingRequest`
- **Response**: Updated `JobPostingResponse`
- **Errors**: 400 invalid status/fields, 403 unauthorized, 404 not found

- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `200 OK`
- **Errors**: 400 invalid status, 403 unauthorized

- **Errors**: 400 invalid status, 403 step-up failed

- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `200 OK`
- **Errors**: 400 invalid status, 403 unauthorized

- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `List<JobPostingHistoryResponse>`

# ShiftWorks JobOps — API Specification

## Authentication

### POST /api/auth/login
- **Auth**: None
- **Body**: `{ "username": "string", "password": "string", "captchaId": "string?", "captchaAnswer": "string?" }`
- **Response**: `{ "user": {...}, "csrfToken": "string", "passwordExpired": boolean }
- **Errors**: 401 Unauthorized (invalid creds or captcha required, includes `captchaRequired`/`remainingAttempts` fields)

### POST /api/auth/logout
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `204 No Content`
- **Errors**: 401 when not authenticated

### POST /api/auth/register
- **Auth**: None
- **Body**: `{ "username": "string", "email": "string", "password": "string" }`
- **Response**: `201 Created` user payload
- **Errors**: 400 bad password, 409 duplicate username/email

### GET /api/auth/captcha
- **Auth**: None
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `{ "captchaId": "string", "image": "data:image/png;base64,..." }`

### POST /api/auth/change-password
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: `{ "newPassword": "string" }`
- **Response**: `200 OK`
- **Errors**: 401 unauthorized, 400 policy violations list

### GET /api/auth/me
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `UserResponse`
- **Errors**: 401 unauthorized

## Job Postings

### GET /api/jobs
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: query parameters `status`, `categoryId`, `locationId`, `search`, `page`, `size`, `sort`, `direction`
- **Response**: `PageResponse<JobPostingResponse>` (paged postings for user with masked fields)
- **Errors**: 403 forbidden if role access violation

### GET /api/jobs/summary
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `JobPostingSummaryResponse`

### GET /api/jobs/{id}
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `JobPostingResponse` (masking phone for unauthorized users)
- **Errors**: 404 not found, 403 if access denied

### POST /api/jobs
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: `JobPostingRequest` (title, description, categoryId, locationId, payType, settlementType, payAmount, headcount, weeklyHours, contactPhone, tags, validityStart, validityEnd)
- **Response**: `JobPostingResponse` (new draft)
- **Errors**: 400 validation failures

### PUT /api/jobs/{id}
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: `JobPostingRequest`
- **Response**: Updated `JobPostingResponse`
- **Errors**: 400 invalid status/fields, 403 unauthorized, 404 not found

### POST /api/jobs/{id}/submit
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `200 OK`
- **Errors**: 400 invalid status, 403 unauthorized

### POST /api/jobs/{id}/publish
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: `PublishJobRequest { "stepUpPassword": "string" }`
- **Response**: `200 OK`
- **Errors**: 400 invalid status, 403 step-up failed

### POST /api/jobs/{id}/unpublish
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `200 OK`
- **Errors**: 400 invalid status, 403 unauthorized

### GET /api/jobs/{id}/preview
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `JobPostingPreviewResponse`

### GET /api/jobs/{id}/history
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `List<JobPostingHistoryResponse>`

### POST /api/jobs/{id}/contact-phone
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: `StepUpPhoneRequest { "stepUpPassword": "string" }`
- **Response**: `{ "contactPhone": "string" }`
- **Errors**: 403 step-up failure, 404 not found

## Dictionaries

### GET /api/categories
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `List<CategoryResponse>`

### GET /api/locations
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: Optional `state` query string
- **Response**: `List<LocationResponse>`

### GET /api/locations/states
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `List<String>` (active states)

## Review

### GET /api/review/dashboard
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `ReviewDashboardResponse`

### GET /api/review/queue
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: Query params `page`, `size`
- **Response**: `PageResponse<JobPostingResponse>`

### GET /api/review/jobs/{id}
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `JobPostingResponse`

### GET /api/review/jobs/{id}/diff
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `Map<String, FieldDiff>`

### GET /api/review/jobs/{id}/actions
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `List<ReviewActionResponse>`

### POST /api/review/jobs/{id}/approve
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: `ReviewRationaleRequest { "rationale": "string" }`
- **Response**: `200 OK`

### POST /api/review/jobs/{id}/reject
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: `ReviewRejectRequest { "rationale": "string", "reviewerNotes": "string?" }`
- **Response**: `200 OK`

### POST /api/review/jobs/{id}/takedown
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: `TakedownRequest { "rationale": "string", "stepUpPassword": "string" }`
- **Response**: `200 OK`

## Appeals

### GET /api/appeals
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: Query params `status`, `page`, `size`
- **Response**: `PageResponse<AppealResponse>`

### POST /api/appeals
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: `AppealCreateRequest { "jobPostingId": number, "appealReason": "string" }`
- **Response**: `200 OK`

### GET /api/appeals/{id}
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `AppealDetailResponse`

### POST /api/appeals/{id}/process
- **Auth**: REVIEWER
- **Body**: `AppealProcessRequest { "decision": "GRANTED|DENIED", "reviewerRationale": "string" }`
- **Response**: `200 OK`

## Admin Users

### GET /api/admin/users
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: query params `role`, `status`, `search`, `page`, `size`
- **Response**: `PageResponse<AdminUserResponse>`

### GET /api/admin/users/{id}
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `AdminUserResponse`

### POST /api/admin/users
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: `AdminUserCreateRequest`
- **Response**: `AdminUserResponse`

### PUT /api/admin/users/{id}
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: `AdminUserUpdateRequest`
- **Response**: `AdminUserResponse`

### PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/role
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: `AdminUserRoleChangeRequest`
- **Response**: `200 OK`

### PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/unlock
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `200 OK`

### PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/reset-password
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `ResetPasswordResponse`

## Admin Dictionaries

### GET /api/admin/categories
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `List<AdminCategoryResponse>`

### POST /api/admin/categories
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: `AdminCategoryRequest`
- **Response**: `AdminCategoryResponse`

### PUT /api/admin/categories/{id}
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: `AdminCategoryRequest`
- **Response**: `AdminCategoryResponse`

### DELETE /api/admin/categories/{id}
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `200 OK`

### GET /api/admin/locations
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: optional `state` query param
- **Response**: `List<AdminLocationResponse>`

### POST /api/admin/locations
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: `AdminLocationRequest`
- **Response**: `AdminLocationResponse`

### PUT /api/admin/locations/{id}
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: `AdminLocationRequest`
- **Response**: `AdminLocationResponse`

### DELETE /api/admin/locations/{id}
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `200 OK`

## Claims

### GET /api/claims
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: query params `status`, `page`, `size`
- **Response**: `PageResponse<ClaimResponse>`

### POST /api/claims
- **Auth**: EMPLOYER
- **Body**: `ClaimRequest`
- **Response**: `ClaimResponse`

### GET /api/claims/{id}
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `ClaimResponse`

### PUT /api/claims/{id}
- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: `ClaimUpdateRequest`
- **Response**: `ClaimResponse`

## Tickets

### GET /api/tickets
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: query params `status`, `priority`, `page`, `size`
- **Response**: `PageResponse<TicketResponse>`

### POST /api/tickets
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: `TicketRequest`
- **Response**: `TicketResponse`

### GET /api/tickets/{id}
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: None
- **Response**: `TicketResponse`

- **Auth**: ADMIN
- **Body**: `TicketUpdateRequest`
- **Response**: `TicketResponse`

## Files

### POST /api/files/upload
- **Auth**: Required
- **Body**: multipart form with `file`, `entityType`, `entityId`

# Fix 3 Blockers — app won't compile without these

---

## BLOCKER 1 — DashboardController missing import

**File:** `backend/src/main/java/com/shiftworks/jobops/controller/DashboardController.java`

Add this import after the existing imports (around line 22):

```java
import com.shiftworks.jobops.security.AuthenticatedUser;
```

The class casts `authentication.getPrincipal()` to `AuthenticatedUser` in 6 places but never imports it.

---

## BLOCKER 2 — DashboardService calls undefined method

**File:** `backend/src/main/java/com/shiftworks/jobops/service/DashboardService.java`

Find line 205:
```java
if (userRoleRequiresPending()) { /* placeholder to avoid compile errors */ }
```

Delete that entire line. The method `userRoleRequiresPending()` does not exist anywhere.

---

## BLOCKER 3 — report_exports schema missing file_size column

The `ReportExport` entity maps a `file_size` column, but the SQL schema doesn't define it. Hibernate crashes at startup with `ddl-auto: validate`.

**File 1:** `init-db/01-schema.sql` — find the `report_exports` table and add `file_size BIGINT DEFAULT 0` after the `file_path` line:

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS report_exports (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    dashboard_config_id BIGINT,
    file_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    file_size BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
    is_masked BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);
```

**File 2:** `backend/src/main/resources/db/schema.sql` — make the exact same change to `report_exports`.

-- ShiftWorks JobOps — Full Database Schema
-- Place this file at: init-db/01-schema.sql AND backend/src/main/resources/db/schema.sql

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    role ENUM('EMPLOYER','REVIEWER','ADMIN') NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('ACTIVE','LOCKED','DISABLED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
    failed_login_attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    locked_until TIMESTAMP NULL,
    captcha_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    password_changed_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    INDEX idx_users_role (role)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_sessions (
    id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    last_active_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    absolute_expiry TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    is_valid BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    csrf_token VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    ip_address VARCHAR(45),
    user_agent VARCHAR(512),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    INDEX idx_sessions_user (user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS categories (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description VARCHAR(500),
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    state VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    city VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UNIQUE KEY uk_state_city (state, city),
    INDEX idx_locations_state (state)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_postings (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    employer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    category_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    location_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    pay_type ENUM('HOURLY','FLAT') NOT NULL,
    pay_amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
    settlement_type ENUM('WEEKLY','END_OF_SHIFT') NOT NULL,
    headcount INT NOT NULL,
    weekly_hours DECIMAL(4,1) NOT NULL,
    contact_phone VARCHAR(500),
    status ENUM('DRAFT','PENDING_REVIEW','APPROVED','PUBLISHED','REJECTED','UNPUBLISHED','TAKEN_DOWN','APPEAL_PENDING') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
    validity_start DATE,
    validity_end DATE,
    reviewer_notes TEXT,
    takedown_reason TEXT,
    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (employer_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (location_id) REFERENCES locations(id),
    INDEX idx_jobs_employer (employer_id),
    INDEX idx_jobs_status (status)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_posting_tags (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_posting_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    tag_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (job_posting_id) REFERENCES job_postings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_posting_history (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_posting_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    previous_status VARCHAR(30),
    new_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    changed_by BIGINT NOT NULL,
    change_reason TEXT,
    snapshot_json JSON,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (job_posting_id) REFERENCES job_postings(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (changed_by) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_actions (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_posting_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    reviewer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    action ENUM('APPROVE','REJECT','TAKEDOWN') NOT NULL,
    rationale TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (job_posting_id) REFERENCES job_postings(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (reviewer_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appeals (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_posting_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    employer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    appeal_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('PENDING','GRANTED','DENIED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    reviewer_id BIGINT,
    reviewer_rationale TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (job_posting_id) REFERENCES job_postings(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (employer_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (reviewer_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS claims (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_posting_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    claimant_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','RESOLVED','CLOSED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
    description TEXT,
    resolution TEXT,
    assigned_to BIGINT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (job_posting_id) REFERENCES job_postings(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (claimant_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (assigned_to) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tickets (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    reporter_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    subject VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','RESOLVED','CLOSED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
    priority ENUM('LOW','MEDIUM','HIGH','CRITICAL') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MEDIUM',
    assigned_to BIGINT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (reporter_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (assigned_to) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS file_attachments (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    entity_type ENUM('CLAIM','APPEAL','TICKET') NOT NULL,
    entity_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    original_filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    stored_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    file_type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    file_size BIGINT NOT NULL,
    checksum VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('ACTIVE','QUARANTINED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
    uploaded_by BIGINT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (uploaded_by) REFERENCES users(id),
    INDEX idx_files_entity (entity_type, entity_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT,
    action VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    entity_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    entity_id BIGINT,
    before_value JSON,
    after_value JSON,
    ip_address VARCHAR(45),
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    INDEX idx_audit_entity (entity_type, entity_id),
    INDEX idx_audit_time (created_at)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dashboard_configs (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    metrics_json JSON NOT NULL,
    dimensions_json JSON,
    filters_json JSON,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scheduled_reports (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    dashboard_config_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    cron_expression VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    last_run_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
    next_run_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
