-- ShiftWorks JobOps — Full Database Schema
-- Place this file at: init-db/01-schema.sql AND backend/src/main/resources/db/schema.sql

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    role ENUM('EMPLOYER','REVIEWER','ADMIN') NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('ACTIVE','LOCKED','DISABLED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
    failed_login_attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    locked_until TIMESTAMP NULL,
    captcha_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    password_changed_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    INDEX idx_users_role (role)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_sessions (
    id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    last_active_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    absolute_expiry TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    is_valid BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    csrf_token VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    ip_address VARCHAR(45),
    user_agent VARCHAR(512),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    INDEX idx_sessions_user (user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS categories (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description VARCHAR(500),
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    state VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    city VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UNIQUE KEY uk_state_city (state, city),
    INDEX idx_locations_state (state)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_postings (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    employer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    category_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    location_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    pay_type ENUM('HOURLY','FLAT') NOT NULL,
    pay_amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
    settlement_type ENUM('WEEKLY','END_OF_SHIFT') NOT NULL,
    headcount INT NOT NULL,
    weekly_hours DECIMAL(4,1) NOT NULL,
    contact_phone VARCHAR(500),
    status ENUM('DRAFT','PENDING_REVIEW','APPROVED','PUBLISHED','REJECTED','UNPUBLISHED','TAKEN_DOWN','APPEAL_PENDING') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
    validity_start DATE,
    validity_end DATE,
    reviewer_notes TEXT,
    takedown_reason TEXT,
    published_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (employer_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (location_id) REFERENCES locations(id),
    INDEX idx_jobs_employer (employer_id),
    INDEX idx_jobs_status (status)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_posting_tags (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_posting_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    tag_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (job_posting_id) REFERENCES job_postings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_posting_history (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_posting_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    previous_status VARCHAR(30),
    new_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    changed_by BIGINT NOT NULL,
    change_reason TEXT,
    snapshot_json JSON,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (job_posting_id) REFERENCES job_postings(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (changed_by) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_actions (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_posting_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    reviewer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    action ENUM('APPROVE','REJECT','TAKEDOWN') NOT NULL,
    rationale TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (job_posting_id) REFERENCES job_postings(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (reviewer_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appeals (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_posting_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    employer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    appeal_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('PENDING','GRANTED','DENIED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    reviewer_id BIGINT,
    reviewer_rationale TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (job_posting_id) REFERENCES job_postings(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (employer_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (reviewer_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS claims (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_posting_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    claimant_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','RESOLVED','CLOSED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
    description TEXT,
    resolution TEXT,
    assigned_to BIGINT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (job_posting_id) REFERENCES job_postings(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (claimant_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (assigned_to) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tickets (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    reporter_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    subject VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','RESOLVED','CLOSED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
    priority ENUM('LOW','MEDIUM','HIGH','CRITICAL') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MEDIUM',
    assigned_to BIGINT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (reporter_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (assigned_to) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS file_attachments (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    entity_type ENUM('CLAIM','APPEAL','TICKET') NOT NULL,
    entity_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    original_filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    stored_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    file_type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    file_size BIGINT NOT NULL,
    checksum VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('ACTIVE','QUARANTINED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
    uploaded_by BIGINT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (uploaded_by) REFERENCES users(id),
    INDEX idx_files_entity (entity_type, entity_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT,
    action VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    entity_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    entity_id BIGINT,
    before_value JSON,

    ip_address VARCHAR(45),
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    INDEX idx_audit_entity (entity_type, entity_id),
    INDEX idx_audit_time (created_at)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dashboard_configs (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    metrics_json JSON NOT NULL,
    dimensions_json JSON,

    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

14: import org.springframework.http.ResponseCookie;
15: import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
16: import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
17: import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
18: import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.WebAuthenticationDetailsSource;
19: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
20: import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
21: 
22: import java.io.IOException;
23: import java.time.Duration;
24: import java.time.Instant;
25: import java.util.List;
26: 
27: @Slf4j
28: @Component
29: @RequiredArgsConstructor
30: public class SessionAuthFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
31: 
32:     public static final String SESSION_REQUEST_ATTRIBUTE = "SHIFTWORKS_ACTIVE_SESSION";
33: 
34:     private final SessionService sessionService;
35:     private final AppProperties appProperties;
36: 
37:     @Override
38:     protected boolean shouldNotFilter(HttpServletRequest request) {
39:         return !request.getRequestURI().startsWith("/api/");
40:     }
41: 
42:     @Override
43:     protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, FilterChain filterChain) throws ServletException, IOException {
44:         try {
45:             UserSession session = (UserSession) request.getAttribute(SESSION_REQUEST_ATTRIBUTE);
46:             if (session == null) {
47:                 session = CookieUtils.getCookie(request, SessionService.SESSION_COOKIE)
48:                     .flatMap(sessionService::findValidSession)
49:                     .orElse(null);
50:             }
51:             if (session != null) {
52:                 if (isExpired(session)) {
53:                     sessionService.invalidateSession(session);
54:                     expireCookies(response);
55:                 } else {
56:                     sessionService.touchSession(session);
57:                     request.setAttribute(SESSION_REQUEST_ATTRIBUTE, session);
58:                     establishSecurityContext(request, session);
59:                 }
60:             }
61:         } catch (Exception ex) {
62:             log.error("Session authentication error", ex);
63:         }
64:         filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
65:     }
66: 
67:     private boolean isExpired(UserSession session) {
68:         if (!session.isValid() || session.getAbsoluteExpiry().isBefore(Instant.now())) {
69:             return true;
70:         }
71:         Duration idleLimit = Duration.ofMinutes(appProperties.getSession().getIdleTimeoutMinutes());
72:         return session.getLastActiveAt().plus(idleLimit).isBefore(Instant.now());
73:     }
74: 
75:     private void establishSecurityContext(HttpServletRequest request, UserSession session) {
76:         UserRole role = session.getUser().getRole();
77:         AuthenticatedUser principal = new AuthenticatedUser(session.getUser().getId(), session.getUser().getUsername(), role);
78:         UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken authenticationToken = new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(principal, null,
79:             List.of(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_" + role.name())));
80:         authenticationToken.setDetails(new WebAuthenticationDetailsSource().buildDetails(request));
81:         SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(authenticationToken);
82:     }
83: 
84:     private void expireCookies(HttpServletResponse response) {
85:         ResponseCookie sessionCookie = ResponseCookie.from(SessionService.SESSION_COOKIE, "")
86:             .path("/")
87:             .maxAge(0)
88:             .httpOnly(true)
89:             .sameSite("Strict")
90:             .build();
91:         ResponseCookie csrfCookie = ResponseCookie.from(SessionService.CSRF_COOKIE, "")
92:             .path("/")
93:             .maxAge(0)
94:             .httpOnly(false)
95:             .sameSite("Strict")
96:             .build();
97:         response.addHeader("Set-Cookie", sessionCookie.toString());
98:         response.addHeader("Set-Cookie", csrfCookie.toString());
99:     }

# Fix ALL 6 API test scripts — CSRF header + field names

The `CsrfValidationFilter` requires `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header on all POST/PUT/DELETE requests (except login/register). Without it, every mutating request gets 403.

---

## CROSS-CUTTING FIX — Add CSRF token extraction to ALL scripts

Every script that logs in must:
1. Capture the full login response body (not just status code)
2. Extract the `csrfToken` from the JSON response
3. Send `-H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF"` on every subsequent POST/PUT/DELETE

---

## FIX 1 — test_auth.sh

**File:** `API_tests/test_auth.sh`

**Change 1:** The login call (line 15-18) must capture the response body too. Replace:

```bash
CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -c /tmp/auth_cookies.txt \
  -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin@123456789"}')
check "Valid login returns 200" "200" "$CODE"
```

with:

```bash
LOGIN_OUT=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -c /tmp/auth_cookies.txt \
  -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin@123456789"}')
CODE=$(echo "$LOGIN_OUT" | tail -1)
BODY=$(echo "$LOGIN_OUT" | sed '$d')
CSRF=$(echo "$BODY" | jq -r .csrfToken)
check "Valid login returns 200" "200" "$CODE"
```


**Change 3:** Logout (line 56) needs CSRF:

#!/bin/bash
BASE=http://localhost:8080/api
PASS=0; FAIL=0
ADMIN_COOKIE=/tmp/api_admin.cookie
EMPLOYER_COOKIE=/tmp/api_emp.cookie

check() {
  local desc="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
  if [ "$expected" = "$actual" ]; then
    echo "PASS: $desc"; PASS=$((PASS+1))
  else
    echo "FAIL: $desc (expected=$expected, got=$actual)"; FAIL=$((FAIL+1))
  fi
}

curl -s -o /dev/null -c "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin@123456789"}'

CATEGORY_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/categories" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"Test Category"}')
CATEGORY_CODE=${CATEGORY_RESPONSE: -3}
CATEGORY_BODY=${CATEGORY_RESPONSE:0:-3}
CATEGORY_ID=$(echo "$CATEGORY_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create category" "200" "$CATEGORY_CODE"

LOCATION_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/locations" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"CA","city":"Los Angeles"}')
LOCATION_CODE=${LOCATION_RESPONSE: -3}
LOCATION_BODY=${LOCATION_RESPONSE:0:-3}
LOCATION_ID=$(echo "$LOCATION_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create location" "200" "$LOCATION_CODE"

EMPLOYER_USER="job_emp_$(date +%s)"
curl -s -o /dev/null -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/users" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER\",\"email\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER@test.com\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\",\"role\":\"EMPLOYER\"}"

curl -s -o /dev/null -c "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\"}"

VALID_JOB_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "title": "Test Job Posting Title Here",
  "description": "This is a test job posting with enough description text to pass validation",
  "categoryId": $CATEGORY_ID,
  "locationId": $LOCATION_ID,
  "payType": "HOURLY",
  "settlementType": "WEEKLY",
  "payAmount": 25.00,
  "headcount": 5,
  "weeklyHours": 20,
  "contactPhone": "555-123-4567",
  "tags": ["test"]
}
EOF
)

CREATE_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$VALID_JOB_BODY")
CREATE_CODE=${CREATE_OUTPUT: -3}
CREATE_BODY=${CREATE_OUTPUT:0:-3}
JOB_ID=$(echo "$CREATE_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create job returns 200" "200" "$CREATE_CODE"

GET_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X GET "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID")
GET_CODE=${GET_OUTPUT: -3}
GET_BODY=${GET_OUTPUT:0:-3}
STATUS=$(echo "$GET_BODY" | jq -r .status)
check "Get job returns 200" "200" "$GET_CODE"
check "Job starts as DRAFT" "DRAFT" "$STATUS"

EDIT_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "title": "Updated Title",
  "description": "This is a test job posting with enough description text to pass validation",
  "categoryId": $CATEGORY_ID,
  "locationId": $LOCATION_ID,
  "payType": "HOURLY",
  "settlementType": "WEEKLY",
  "payAmount": 25.00,
  "headcount": 5,
  "weeklyHours": 20,
  "contactPhone": "555-123-4567",
  "tags": ["test"]
}
EOF
)

EDIT_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X PUT "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$EDIT_BODY")
EDIT_CODE=${EDIT_OUTPUT: -3}
check "Edit draft job returns 200" "200" "$EDIT_CODE"

SUBMIT_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID/submit")
check "Submit for review returns 200" "200" "$SUBMIT_CODE"

POST_SUBMIT_EDIT_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X PUT "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$EDIT_BODY")
check "Edit after submit returns 400" "400" "$POST_SUBMIT_EDIT_CODE"

LOW_PAY_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "title": "Low Pay Job",
  "description": "This is a test job posting with enough description text to pass validation",
  "categoryId": $CATEGORY_ID,
  "locationId": $LOCATION_ID,
  "payType": "HOURLY",
  "settlementType": "WEEKLY",
  "payAmount": 11.00,
  "headcount": 5,
  "weeklyHours": 20,
  "contactPhone": "555-123-4567",
  "tags": ["test"]
}
EOF
)

LOW_PAY_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$LOW_PAY_BODY")
check "Hourly pay below 12 returns 400" "400" "$LOW_PAY_CODE"

ZERO_HEADCOUNT_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "title": "Zero Headcount",
  "description": "This is a test job posting with enough description text to pass validation",
  "categoryId": $CATEGORY_ID,
  "locationId": $LOCATION_ID,
  "payType": "HOURLY",
  "settlementType": "WEEKLY",
  "payAmount": 25.00,
  "headcount": 0,
  "weeklyHours": 20,
  "contactPhone": "555-123-4567",
  "tags": ["test"]
}
EOF
)

ZERO_HEADCOUNT_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$ZERO_HEADCOUNT_BODY")
check "Headcount 0 returns 400" "400" "$ZERO_HEADCOUNT_CODE"

echo ""
echo "Results: $PASS passed, $FAIL failed"
rm -f "$ADMIN_COOKIE" "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE"
exit $FAIL

#!/bin/bash
BASE=http://localhost:8080/api
PASS=0; FAIL=0
ADMIN_COOKIE=/tmp/files_admin.cookie
EMPLOYER_COOKIE=/tmp/files_emp.cookie

check() {
  local desc="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
  if [ "$expected" = "$actual" ]; then
    echo "PASS: $desc"; PASS=$((PASS+1))
  else
    echo "FAIL: $desc (expected=$expected, got=$actual)"; FAIL=$((FAIL+1))
  fi
}

curl -s -o /dev/null -c "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin@123456789"}'

CATEGORY_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/categories" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"FileCategory"}')
CATEGORY_CODE=${CATEGORY_RESPONSE: -3}
CATEGORY_BODY=${CATEGORY_RESPONSE:0:-3}
CATEGORY_ID=$(echo "$CATEGORY_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create category" "200" "$CATEGORY_CODE"

LOCATION_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/locations" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"TX","city":"Austin"}')
LOCATION_CODE=${LOCATION_RESPONSE: -3}
LOCATION_BODY=${LOCATION_RESPONSE:0:-3}
LOCATION_ID=$(echo "$LOCATION_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create location" "200" "$LOCATION_CODE"

EMPLOYER_USER="files_emp_$(date +%s)"
curl -s -o /dev/null -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/users" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER\",\"email\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER@test.com\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\",\"role\":\"EMPLOYER\"}"

curl -s -o /dev/null -c "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\"}"

JOB_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "title": "File Test Job",
  "description": "Job used to create a claim for file uploads",
  "categoryId": $CATEGORY_ID,
  "locationId": $LOCATION_ID,
  "payType": "HOURLY",
  "settlementType": "WEEKLY",
  "payAmount": 30.00,
  "headcount": 3,
  "weeklyHours": 30,
  "contactPhone": "555-987-0000",
  "tags": ["files"]
}
EOF
)

CREATE_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$JOB_BODY")
CREATE_CODE=${CREATE_OUTPUT: -3}
CREATE_BODY=${CREATE_OUTPUT:0:-3}
JOB_ID=$(echo "$CREATE_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create job for claim" "200" "$CREATE_CODE"

CLAIM_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/claims" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"jobPostingId\":$JOB_ID,\"description\":\"Files test claim\"}")
CLAIM_CODE=${CLAIM_OUTPUT: -3}
CLAIM_BODY=${CLAIM_OUTPUT:0:-3}
CLAIM_ID=$(echo "$CLAIM_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create claim" "200" "$CLAIM_CODE"

printf '%%PDF-1.4 test content here' > /tmp/test_upload.pdf
UPLOAD_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -F "file=@/tmp/test_upload.pdf" -F "entityType=CLAIM" -F "entityId=$CLAIM_ID" "$BASE/files/upload")
UPLOAD_CODE=${UPLOAD_OUTPUT: -3}
UPLOAD_BODY=${UPLOAD_OUTPUT:0:-3}
FILE_ID=$(echo "$UPLOAD_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Upload valid PDF returns 200" "200" "$UPLOAD_CODE"

dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/bigfile.pdf bs=1M count=11 2>/dev/null
BIG_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -F "file=@/tmp/bigfile.pdf" -F "entityType=CLAIM" -F "entityId=$CLAIM_ID" "$BASE/files/upload")
check "Oversized file returns 400" "400" "$BIG_CODE"

printf 'MZ' > /tmp/test.exe
EXE_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -F "file=@/tmp/test.exe" -F "entityType=CLAIM" -F "entityId=$CLAIM_ID" "$BASE/files/upload")
check "Wrong type returns 400" "400" "$EXE_CODE"

DOWNLOAD_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" "$BASE/files/$FILE_ID/download")
check "Download file returns 200" "200" "$DOWNLOAD_CODE"

echo ""
echo "Results: $PASS passed, $FAIL failed"
rm -f /tmp/test_upload.pdf /tmp/bigfile.pdf /tmp/test.exe "$ADMIN_COOKIE" "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE"
exit $FAIL

#!/bin/bash
BASE=http://localhost:8080/api
PASS=0; FAIL=0
ADMIN_COOKIE=/tmp/api_admin.cookie
EMPLOYER_COOKIE=/tmp/api_emp.cookie

check() {
  local desc="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
  if [ "$expected" = "$actual" ]; then
    echo "PASS: $desc"; PASS=$((PASS+1))
  else
    echo "FAIL: $desc (expected=$expected, got=$actual)"; FAIL=$((FAIL+1))
  fi
}

ADMIN_OUT=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -c "$ADMIN_COOKIE" \
  -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin@123456789"}')
CSRF_ADMIN=$(echo "$ADMIN_OUT" | sed '$d' | jq -r .csrfToken)

CATEGORY_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/categories" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_ADMIN" \
  -d '{"name":"Test Category"}')
CATEGORY_CODE=${CATEGORY_RESPONSE: -3}
CATEGORY_BODY=${CATEGORY_RESPONSE:0:-3}
CATEGORY_ID=$(echo "$CATEGORY_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create category" "200" "$CATEGORY_CODE"

LOCATION_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/locations" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_ADMIN" \
  -d '{"state":"CA","city":"Los Angeles"}')
LOCATION_CODE=${LOCATION_RESPONSE: -3}
LOCATION_BODY=${LOCATION_RESPONSE:0:-3}
LOCATION_ID=$(echo "$LOCATION_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create location" "200" "$LOCATION_CODE"

EMPLOYER_USER="job_emp_$(date +%s)"
curl -s -o /dev/null -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/users" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_ADMIN" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER\",\"email\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER@test.com\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\",\"role\":\"EMPLOYER\"}"

EMP_OUT=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -c "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" \
  -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\"}")
CSRF_EMP=$(echo "$EMP_OUT" | sed '$d' | jq -r .csrfToken)

VALID_JOB_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "title": "Test Job Posting Title Here",
  "description": "This is a test job posting with enough description text to pass validation",
  "categoryId": $CATEGORY_ID,
  "locationId": $LOCATION_ID,
  "payType": "HOURLY",
  "settlementType": "WEEKLY",
  "payAmount": 25.00,
  "headcount": 5,
  "weeklyHours": 20,
  "contactPhone": "555-123-4567",
  "tags": ["test"],
  "validityStart": "2026-01-01",
  "validityEnd": "2026-01-31"
}
EOF
)

CREATE_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP" \
  -d "$VALID_JOB_BODY")
CREATE_CODE=${CREATE_OUTPUT: -3}
CREATE_BODY=${CREATE_OUTPUT:0:-3}
JOB_ID=$(echo "$CREATE_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create job returns 200" "200" "$CREATE_CODE"

GET_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X GET "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID")
GET_CODE=${GET_OUTPUT: -3}
GET_BODY=${GET_OUTPUT:0:-3}
STATUS=$(echo "$GET_BODY" | jq -r .status)
check "Get job returns 200" "200" "$GET_CODE"
check "Job starts as DRAFT" "DRAFT" "$STATUS"

EDIT_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "title": "Updated Title",
  "description": "This is a test job posting with enough description text to pass validation",
  "categoryId": $CATEGORY_ID,
  "locationId": $LOCATION_ID,
  "payType": "HOURLY",
  "settlementType": "WEEKLY",
  "payAmount": 25.00,
  "headcount": 5,
  "weeklyHours": 20,
  "contactPhone": "555-123-4567",
  "tags": ["test"],
  "validityStart": "2026-01-01",
  "validityEnd": "2026-01-31"
}
EOF
)

EDIT_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X PUT "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP" \
  -d "$EDIT_BODY")
EDIT_CODE=${EDIT_OUTPUT: -3}
check "Edit draft job returns 200" "200" "$EDIT_CODE"

SUBMIT_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID/submit" \
  -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP")
check "Submit for review returns 200" "200" "$SUBMIT_CODE"

POST_SUBMIT_EDIT_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X PUT "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP" \
  -d "$EDIT_BODY")
check "Edit after submit returns 400" "400" "$POST_SUBMIT_EDIT_CODE"

LOW_PAY_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "title": "Low Pay Job",
  "description": "This is a test job posting with enough description text to pass validation",
  "categoryId": $CATEGORY_ID,
  "locationId": $LOCATION_ID,
  "payType": "HOURLY",
  "settlementType": "WEEKLY",
  "payAmount": 11.00,
  "headcount": 5,
  "weeklyHours": 20,
  "contactPhone": "555-123-4567",
  "tags": ["test"],
  "validityStart": "2026-01-01",
  "validityEnd": "2026-01-31"
}
EOF
)

LOW_PAY_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP" \
  -d "$LOW_PAY_BODY")
check "Hourly pay below 12 returns 400" "400" "$LOW_PAY_CODE"

ZERO_HEADCOUNT_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "title": "Zero Headcount",
  "description": "This is a test job posting with enough description text to pass validation",
  "categoryId": $CATEGORY_ID,
  "locationId": $LOCATION_ID,
  "payType": "HOURLY",
  "settlementType": "WEEKLY",
  "payAmount": 25.00,
  "headcount": 0,
  "weeklyHours": 20,
  "contactPhone": "555-123-4567",
  "tags": ["test"],
  "validityStart": "2026-01-01",
  "validityEnd": "2026-01-31"
}
EOF
)

ZERO_HEADCOUNT_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP" \
  -d "$ZERO_HEADCOUNT_BODY")
check "Headcount 0 returns 400" "400" "$ZERO_HEADCOUNT_CODE"

echo ""
echo "Results: $PASS passed, $FAIL failed"
rm -f "$ADMIN_COOKIE" "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE"
exit $FAIL

```bash
#!/bin/bash
BASE=http://localhost:8080/api
PASS=0; FAIL=0
ADMIN_COOKIE=/tmp/review_admin.cookie
EMPLOYER_COOKIE=/tmp/review_emp.cookie
REVIEWER_COOKIE=/tmp/review_rev.cookie

check() {
  local desc="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
  if [ "$expected" = "$actual" ]; then
    echo "PASS: $desc"; PASS=$((PASS+1))
  else
    echo "FAIL: $desc (expected=$expected, got=$actual)"; FAIL=$((FAIL+1))
  fi
}

# Admin login — capture CSRF
ADMIN_OUT=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -c "$ADMIN_COOKIE" \
  -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin@123456789"}')
CSRF_ADMIN=$(echo "$ADMIN_OUT" | sed '$d' | jq -r .csrfToken)

CATEGORY_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/categories" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_ADMIN" \
  -d '{"name":"Review Category"}')
CATEGORY_CODE=${CATEGORY_RESPONSE: -3}
CATEGORY_BODY=${CATEGORY_RESPONSE:0:-3}
CATEGORY_ID=$(echo "$CATEGORY_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create review category" "200" "$CATEGORY_CODE"

LOCATION_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/locations" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_ADMIN" \
  -d '{"state":"NY","city":"New York"}')
LOCATION_CODE=${LOCATION_RESPONSE: -3}
LOCATION_BODY=${LOCATION_RESPONSE:0:-3}
LOCATION_ID=$(echo "$LOCATION_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create review location" "200" "$LOCATION_CODE"

EMPLOYER_USER="review_emp_$(date +%s)"
REVIEWER_USER="review_rev_$(date +%s)"

curl -s -o /dev/null -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/users" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_ADMIN" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER\",\"email\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER@test.com\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\",\"role\":\"EMPLOYER\"}"

curl -s -o /dev/null -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/users" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_ADMIN" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$REVIEWER_USER\",\"email\":\"$REVIEWER_USER@test.com\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\",\"role\":\"REVIEWER\"}"

# Employer login — capture CSRF
EMP_OUT=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -c "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" \
  -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\"}")
CSRF_EMP=$(echo "$EMP_OUT" | sed '$d' | jq -r .csrfToken)

# Reviewer login — capture CSRF
REV_OUT=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -c "$REVIEWER_COOKIE" \
  -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$REVIEWER_USER\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\"}")
CSRF_REV=$(echo "$REV_OUT" | sed '$d' | jq -r .csrfToken)

JOB_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "title": "Review Flow Job",
  "description": "This is a review job posting used in automated tests",
  "categoryId": $CATEGORY_ID,
  "locationId": $LOCATION_ID,
  "payType": "HOURLY",
  "settlementType": "WEEKLY",
  "payAmount": 35.00,
  "headcount": 4,
  "weeklyHours": 30,
  "contactPhone": "555-987-6543",
  "tags": ["review"]
}
EOF
)

CREATE_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP" \
  -d "$JOB_BODY")
CREATE_CODE=${CREATE_OUTPUT: -3}
CREATE_BODY=${CREATE_OUTPUT:0:-3}
JOB_ID=$(echo "$CREATE_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create job for review" "200" "$CREATE_CODE"

SUBMIT_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" \
  -X POST "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID/submit" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP")
check "Submit job for review" "200" "$SUBMIT_CODE"

APPROVE_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$REVIEWER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/review/jobs/$JOB_ID/approve" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_REV" \
  -d '{"rationale":"Looks good, approved for posting"}')
check "Reviewer approves job" "200" "$APPROVE_CODE"

PUBLISH_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID/publish" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP" \
  -d '{"stepUpPassword":"StrongPass123!"}')
check "Employer publishes job" "200" "$PUBLISH_CODE"

TAKEDOWN_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$REVIEWER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/review/jobs/$JOB_ID/takedown" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_REV" \
  -d '{"rationale":"Policy violation found in posting","stepUpPassword":"StrongPass123!"}')
check "Reviewer takedowns job" "200" "$TAKEDOWN_CODE"

APPEAL_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "jobPostingId": $JOB_ID,
  "appealReason": "The posting complies with all policies and should be reinstated"
}
EOF
)

APPEAL_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/appeals" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP" \
  -d "$APPEAL_BODY")
check "Employer creates appeal" "200" "$APPEAL_CODE"

APPEALS_LIST=$(curl -s -b "$REVIEWER_COOKIE" -X GET "$BASE/appeals")
APPEAL_ID=$(echo "$APPEALS_LIST" | jq -r '.items[0].id // .[0].id')

PROCESS_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$REVIEWER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/appeals/$APPEAL_ID/process" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_REV" \
  -d '{"decision":"GRANTED","reviewerRationale":"Appeal is valid, reinstating the posting"}')
check "Reviewer processes appeal" "200" "$PROCESS_CODE"

FINAL_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X GET "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID")
FINAL_CODE=${FINAL_OUTPUT: -3}
FINAL_BODY=${FINAL_OUTPUT:0:-3}
FINAL_STATUS=$(echo "$FINAL_BODY" | jq -r .status)
check "Final job GET returns 200" "200" "$FINAL_CODE"
check "Job status is PUBLISHED" "PUBLISHED" "$FINAL_STATUS"

echo ""
echo "Results: $PASS passed, $FAIL failed"
rm -f "$ADMIN_COOKIE" "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" "$REVIEWER_COOKIE"
exit $FAIL
```

#!/bin/bash
BASE=http://localhost:8080/api
PASS=0; FAIL=0
ADMIN_COOKIE=/tmp/review_admin.cookie
EMPLOYER_COOKIE=/tmp/review_emp.cookie
REVIEWER_COOKIE=/tmp/review_rev.cookie

check() {
  local desc="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
  if [ "$expected" = "$actual" ]; then
    echo "PASS: $desc"; PASS=$((PASS+1))
  else
    echo "FAIL: $desc (expected=$expected, got=$actual)"; FAIL=$((FAIL+1))
  fi
}

CURL_COMMAND_PLACEHOLDER

CATEGORY_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/categories" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"Review Category"}')
CATEGORY_CODE=${CATEGORY_RESPONSE: -3}
CATEGORY_BODY=${CATEGORY_RESPONSE:0:-3}
CATEGORY_ID=$(echo "$CATEGORY_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create review category" "200" "$CATEGORY_CODE"

LOCATION_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/locations" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"NY","city":"New York"}')
LOCATION_CODE=${LOCATION_RESPONSE: -3}
LOCATION_BODY=${LOCATION_RESPONSE:0:-3}
LOCATION_ID=$(echo "$LOCATION_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create review location" "200" "$LOCATION_CODE"

EMPLOYER_USER="review_emp_$(date +%s)"
REVIEWER_USER="review_rev_$(date +%s)"

curl -s -o /dev/null -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/users" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER\",\"email\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER@test.com\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\",\"role\":\"EMPLOYER\"}"

curl -s -o /dev/null -b "$ADMIN_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/admin/users" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$REVIEWER_USER\",\"email\":\"$REVIEWER_USER@test.com\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\",\"role\":\"REVIEWER\"}"

curl -s -o /dev/null -c "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\"}"

curl -s -o /dev/null -c "$REVIEWER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$REVIEWER_USER\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\"}"

JOB_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "title": "Review Flow Job",
  "description": "This is a review job posting used in automated tests",
  "categoryId": $CATEGORY_ID,
  "locationId": $LOCATION_ID,
  "payType": "HOURLY",
  "settlementType": "WEEKLY",
  "payAmount": 35.00,
  "headcount": 4,
  "weeklyHours": 30,
  "contactPhone": "555-987-6543",
  "tags": ["review"]
}
EOF
)

CREATE_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$JOB_BODY")
CREATE_CODE=${CREATE_OUTPUT: -3}
CREATE_BODY=${CREATE_OUTPUT:0:-3}
JOB_ID=$(echo "$CREATE_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Create job for review" "200" "$CREATE_CODE"

SUBMIT_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID/submit")
check "Submit job for review" "200" "$SUBMIT_CODE"

APPROVE_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$REVIEWER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/review/jobs/$JOB_ID/approve" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"rationale":"Looks good, approved for posting"}')
check "Reviewer approves job" "200" "$APPROVE_CODE"

PUBLISH_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID/publish" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"stepUpPassword":"StrongPass123!"}')
check "Employer publishes job" "200" "$PUBLISH_CODE"

TAKEDOWN_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$REVIEWER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/review/jobs/$JOB_ID/takedown" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"rationale":"Policy violation found in posting","stepUpPassword":"StrongPass123!"}')
check "Reviewer takedowns job" "200" "$TAKEDOWN_CODE"

APPEAL_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "jobPostingId": $JOB_ID,
  "reason": "The posting complies with all policies and should be reinstated"
}
EOF
)

APPEAL_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/appeals" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$APPEAL_BODY")
APPEAL_CODE=${APPEAL_OUTPUT: -3}
APPEAL_BODY_RESP=${APPEAL_OUTPUT:0:-3}
APPEAL_ID=$(echo "$APPEAL_BODY_RESP" | jq -r .id)
check "Employer creates appeal" "200" "$APPEAL_CODE"

PROCESS_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$REVIEWER_COOKIE" -X POST "$BASE/appeals/$APPEAL_ID/process" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"decision":"GRANTED","rationale":"Appeal is valid, reinstating the posting"}')
check "Reviewer processes appeal" "200" "$PROCESS_CODE"

FINAL_OUTPUT=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -b "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" -X GET "$BASE/jobs/$JOB_ID")
FINAL_CODE=${FINAL_OUTPUT: -3}
FINAL_BODY=${FINAL_OUTPUT:0:-3}
FINAL_STATUS=$(echo "$FINAL_BODY" | jq -r .status)
check "Final job GET returns 200" "200" "$FINAL_CODE"
check "Job status is PUBLISHED" "PUBLISHED" "$FINAL_STATUS"

echo ""
echo "Results: $PASS passed, $FAIL failed"
rm -f "$ADMIN_COOKIE" "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE" "$REVIEWER_COOKIE"
exit $FAIL

  -d "{\"username\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER\",\"email\":\"$EMPLOYER_USER@test.com\",\"password\":\"StrongPass123!\",\"role\":\"EMPLOYER\"}"

```bash
{
  "title": "File Test Job",

)

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP" \
  -d "{\"jobPostingId\":$JOB_ID,\"description\":\"Files test claim\"}")

check "Create claim" "200" "$CLAIM_CODE"

  -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP" \
  -F "file=@/tmp/test_upload.pdf" -F "entityType=CLAIM" -F "entityId=$CLAIM_ID" \
  "$BASE/files/upload")
UPLOAD_CODE=${UPLOAD_OUTPUT: -3}
UPLOAD_BODY=${UPLOAD_OUTPUT:0:-3}
FILE_ID=$(echo "$UPLOAD_BODY" | jq -r .id)
check "Upload valid PDF returns 200" "200" "$UPLOAD_CODE"

  -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP" \
  -F "file=@/tmp/bigfile.pdf" -F "entityType=CLAIM" -F "entityId=$CLAIM_ID" \
  "$BASE/files/upload")
check "Oversized file returns 400" "400" "$BIG_CODE"

  -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF_EMP" \
  -F "file=@/tmp/test.exe" -F "entityType=CLAIM" -F "entityId=$CLAIM_ID" \

check "Download file returns 200" "200" "$DOWNLOAD_CODE"

echo "Results: $PASS passed, $FAIL failed"
rm -f /tmp/test_upload.pdf /tmp/bigfile.pdf /tmp/test.exe "$ADMIN_COOKIE" "$EMPLOYER_COOKIE"
exit $FAIL
```

+

+check "Download file returns 200" "200" "$DOWNLOAD_CODE"

+echo ""
+echo "Results: $PASS passed, $FAIL failed"
